item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: UltraEdit 25.0.0.180
item.description:
Professional Code Text Editor

UltraEdit is a feature-rich multi-window editor with a flexible and powerful configuration system and multilingual interface, as well as a built-in FTP client. It is mainly for programmers, supports editing text, hex, and HTML files, and provides syntax highlighting capabilities in many programming languages such as C/C + +, VB, HTML, Java, Perl, Fortran, and LaTex. UltraEdit is not only a plain text editor, but also supports the syntax and code structure highlighting of the extended language, with powerful editing, code hints, folding, and column manipulation capabilities. It supports multi-file simultaneous editing, text and hex editing, and complex search and replace operations, including regular expressions and reverse searches. In addition, UltraEdit provides a highly customizable UI that allows users to adjust themes, menus and toolbars according to their personal preferences, supports column mode editing, integrates FTP, SSH and Telnet functions, facilitates remote file management and server data interaction, and is an advanced text, hex and code editor for all types of users.

item.title: Things3 3.24.2
item.description:
macOS Personal Task Manager

Things is a great task management app that helps you plan your schedule, manage projects, and stay on track to achieve your goals. Simple to use, it allows you to sort out trivia in a short period of time, whether it is basic tasks or life goals, can become organized, so that you can focus on the most important things. Things excel at combining design and functionality, providing a wealth of features such as to-do management, project management, zoning, scheduling, etc. with a pleasant user interface that doesn't interfere with your work. Things also offers many other useful features such as reminders, repetitions, schedules for tonight, calendar integration, tags, quick input, quick find, enter any door, widgets, mail to Things, tags, and more. Designed for Mac, Things is a deeply integrated system that quickly creates to-dos from other apps, connects your calendars, adds widgets, imports from reminders, and even integrates shortcuts to automate workflows. Building on a strong 'to-do list' as an essential component — every to-do is a small step towards big achievements. You can note it, tag it, schedule it, or break it down into smaller steps.

item.title: SQLPro Studio 2026.301
item.description:
SQL Editing and Database Management Client

SQLPro Studio is a database management tool designed for Mac users that supports a variety of major SQL database types, including MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server (2005 and above), PostgreSQL, MariaDB, and Oracle (8i and above). The app provides a unified interface that allows users to easily view, save, and extract data, while supporting advanced features such as querying, updating, and comparing query results across multiple tables simultaneously. In addition, SQLPro Studio supports the formatting and validation of SQL statements, with powerful error detection and syntax highlighting, as well as convenient autocompletion features. It also integrates seamlessly with cloud service providers such as Heroku, Amazon's relational database service, and Microsoft Azure, providing great convenience for users using cloud databases. Most importantly, SQLPro Studio provides faster and more stable performance for Mac-native applications that do not rely on Java than the Java-based database management interface.

item.title: Airmail 27.0.2 fix
item.description:
Mac Professional Mailbox Management Tool

Airmail, a fast mail client optimized for macOS and iOS, won the 2017 Apple Design Award for high performance and intuitive user interaction. The app supports a variety of mail services, including iCloud, MS Exchange, Gmail, IMAP, POP3, etc., allowing users to easily manage a single or multiple mailboxes. Airmail offers a unified inbox and quick replies that allow users to easily switch between accounts and quickly access their email through today's extensions and operations. The client supports offline operation and multi-touch gestures. Through global search and real-time filtering functions, users can efficiently manage messages, and provide advanced functions such as delayed delivery, automatic cc and resend when sending. Airmail also allows users to customize a variety of visual themes and email signatures to meet personalized needs, and Airmail Pro subscriptions add additional features such as smart inboxes and new designs to make email processing more efficient and convenient. Airmail is a high-performance email client for macOS and iOS, known for its fast, intuitive interactive experience.

item.title: Syncovery Professional 12.9.7
item.description:
Multi-platform data replication tool

Syncovery Professional is the ultimate synchronization, backup, copy, and migration tool that quickly replicates data as you need it. The tool supports multiple platforms, including Windows, macOS, Linux, FreeBSD, and NAS systems, and can be replicated between local drives, network shares, mobile devices via MTP, or using FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, and more. Syncovery supports multiple cloud storage services such as Google Drive, Box, Amazon S3, Azure, DropBox, OneDrive, Rackspace, Sharepoint, Backblaze B2, Citrix Sharefile, and more. You can create multiple different tasks, run them manually (with sync preview), or have the scheduler run them automatically. Syncovery has a wealth of features, including real-time synchronization, compression, encryption, email notifications, and more, and can be extended with PascalScript.

item.title: Sublime Merge Build 2132
item.description:
High-performance Git client

Sublime Merge is a cross-platform Git client by Sublime Text developers, designed for developers seeking extreme speed and precise control. It uses an efficient cross-platform GUI toolkit, an unparalleled syntax highlighting engine, and a custom high-performance Git read library, allowing operations such as repository opening, file staging, and historical search to be completed instantly, even when handling large repositories without delay. Sublime Merge supports line-by-line and block-by-block staging, allowing users to precisely select one or more lines of code and split the change block into multiple independent submissions for the most flexible change management. Built-in powerful side-by-side contrast, syntax highlighting, and character-level difference display, users can drag and drop change block edges to dynamically adjust the number of context lines and more intuitively review code changes. Instant Search allows you to traverse the entire repository in real time as you type, allowing you to quickly locate the required history by submitting messages, authors, paths, and content. The built-in merge tool helps users easily resolve merge conflicts without switching between other apps.

item.title: DaVinci Fusion Studio 21.1.1
item.description:

DaVinci Fusion Studio is Blackmagic Design's visual effects, node composition, 3D, VR, and motion graphics solution for professional film and television production for macOS, and has long been used in Hollywood movies, TV series, and game cutscenes. It uses efficient node-based working methods, integrating tools such as matting, tracking, painting, transcription, particles, text animation, 3D synthesis, optical flow analysis, stereoscopic 3D, and OpenEXR depth pixel processing into the same environment, making it easy to build complex lenses without transferring material frequently between multiple applications. Fusion 21 adds reusable special effects templates, automatic re-timing of animation curves, audio waveform synchronization, customizable toolbars, node bookmarks, vertical node layouts, and multiple GPU-accelerated Resolve FX, with Metal, CUDA, OpenCL acceleration and unlimited network rendering capabilities to meet the high-voltage production process from broadcast packaging to cinematic special effects.

item.title: Hush 2.8.5

The software provides modes such as desktop masking, active windows, designated apps, and cursor focus, so that the current window or multiple selected apps are clearly displayed and the circular sharp area follows the mouse. The daily mode continuously darkens the background with window switching, supports application exceptions and collaborative application grouping, and makes it easy to view the associated windows such as the editor and simulator at the same time. When screen sharing is detected, masking can be automatically enabled to adjust the display range with the shared state floating window; blur strength, mask color, frosted texture, and custom background images are supported, and multiple monitors can be controlled separately. Users can also operate the software through global shortcuts, temporary pivot of keys, shortcuts, focus mode filters, and URL Scheme. The app resides in the menu bar, supports Chinese, all processing is done locally, no data is collected;

item.title: Shotbolt 1.2.5
item.description:
macOS screenshot annotation software

Shotbolt is a screenshot and screen recording tool for macOS that combines multiple capture methods, layered callouts, text recognition, and history retrieval in one workflow. Unify shortcuts to launch areas, windows, full-screen or timed screenshots, fine-tune selections with freezing screenshots, pixel magnifiers, size tips and arrow keys, and toggle text extraction, scrolling screenshots, video recording, or GIF capture from the action bar. After the screenshot is saved, the arrows, text annotations, and overlays remain separate layers that you can continue to move, hide, adjust, or rotate to make it easier to modify descriptions and protect sensitive information. History supports searching by file name and text in screenshots, and displays the line where the hit text is, with automatic classification and easy-to-read headers to help find elements. Quick access cards support callouts, pinning, and dragging in other apps, and Pro provides automatic desensitization, multi-graph canvas, and more. Text recognition is done by Apple's local technology, and screenshots are only uploaded when the sharing link is actively created, and there is no need to register an account. The software requires macOS 26 or higher and is compatible with Apple chips and Intel Macs.

item.title: TelefonX 1.2.0

Users can sync personal phone books and favorites through iCloud, access shared phone books, read Apple contacts as authorized, and block numbers, SIP addresses, or anonymous calls. The native interface combines menu bar line status, call notifications, focus mode linkage, and music pauses during calls for easy integration into your daily office. The Pro feature further provides multi-line parallelism, call recording, proprietary OpenAI API key generation for recording summaries, callback reminders, dialing rules, and phonebook sharing management. Contacts, call logs, and recordings are saved locally, and sensitive credentials are stored in the macOS keychain.

item.title: ProxyPin 1.4.0
item.description:
Open source HTTPS packet scraping network debugging tool

ProxyPin is an open source HTTP (S) scraping and network debugging tool for macOS. It is developed with Flutter and covers Windows, Android, iOS and Linux. It is suitable for interface debugging, request troubleshooting and response data analysis. It also supports capturing Flutter application traffic. The software can intercept, check and rewrite network requests, limit the scope of scraping through domain name filtering, and find records by keywords, response types, and other conditions. The cross-device connection supports scanning, eliminating the need to manually configure the WiFi proxy, and synchronously configuring and forwarding traffic to each other. For interface debugging, you can use JavaScript to process requests or responses, perform redirects, packet substitutions, and incremental modifications, and also return simulated responses directly through local configuration or scripts. After configuring the AES decryption key, the HTTP message body can be automatically decrypted; Setting a blocking rule by URL prevents the specified request from being sent to the server. Fetching records will be automatically saved, supporting Har format import and export, facilitating backtracking and exchange of debugging data, and providing auxiliary tools such as favorites, commonly used codes, QR codes, and regular expressions.

item.title: Dayflow 2.8.0
item.description:
Screen timeline backtracking tool

Dayflow is an automatic work log and time tracking tool running on macOS. It quietly collects lightweight screen clips in the background. Combined with the artificial intelligence model you choose, it organizes the original screen activities into activity cards and timelines arranged by time, so you can look back at what you really did in a day without a timer or manual notes. It focuses not on a simple window title or front-end app name, but on the specific work that is happening on the screen, so developing features, troubleshooting problems, reviewing merge requests in a code editor, or retrieving data and communicating collaborations in a browser, chat tool, are all written as contextual summaries. The daily station view pulls yesterday's highlights, today's priorities, and roadblocks from the timeline to help you quickly prepare for updates, while the weekly review summarizes focus patterns, time distribution, key applications, and factors that keep you off task. You can also ask for records with periods of one day, one week, or more in natural language, and export timelines for any date range as Markdown for status synchronization, customer notes, or personal review.

item.title: Scroll Reverser 2.1.1
item.description:
Independent Control Tool for Mac Scroll Direction

Scroll Reverser is a scroll direction control tool for macOS, suitable for users who use the trackpad, Magic Mouse, and traditional scroll mouse at the same time. It can set whether to reverse the scrolling direction for the trackpad and mouse respectively, so that the notebook trackpad retains the feel of natural scrolling, while allowing the external mouse to restore the classic scrolling logic, reducing the operation confusion caused by switching back and forth between different devices. For scroll wheel mice, the software can also provide step size adjustment, control the number of rows per scroll wheel step scroll when discontinuous scrolling is detected, and disable system scroll acceleration for a more stable scrolling rhythm. Running as a standalone application, Scroll Reverser does not write deeply to the system, supports menu bar control, login boot, multilingual interface, Intel and Apple Silicon processors, and continuously fixes compatibility issues for the new version of macOS.

item.title: Tinycast 0.12.8
item.description:
Native lightweight all-purpose starter

Tinycast is a native macOS launcher for daily high-frequency operations. Press the global shortcut key to call up the hover panel from any interface, and centralize the application launch, file retrieval, clipboard, calculation conversion, window management and system control into the same portal. The software is implemented with SwiftUI and AppKit. Zero third-party dependencies, no Electron, and no telemetry data are collected. The memory occupancy is usually controlled within 100MB. The launcher supports fuzzy search and favorite sticky. You can view running apps and exit single or all apps. You can also bind a dedicated hotkey for a specific app. Press it once to switch between focusing and hiding. File search directly reuses the system Spotlight, opening files and folders in the folder selected by the user without indexing them yourself. The dictionary function reads the native dictionary and instantly interprets the input entries. Clipboard history overwrites both text and images, allowing you to search and paste back into the app you just used. The calculator performs mathematical operations, unit conversions, and real-time currency-to-cryptocurrency conversions within the panel.

item.title: iTerm2 3.7.7
item.description:
Powerful terminal simulator

iTerm2 is a powerful terminal emulator that provides more terminal operation functions and experiences on macOS systems for professionals such as developers and system administrators. There are split windows, searches, command smart tips plus autocomplete, history, fully definable terminal skin styles, and more. iTerm2 supports multiple tabs and screens, allowing users to run multiple terminals at the same time in the same window, eliminating the need to switch windows frequently and improving productivity. iTerm2 also supports a variety of terminal window appearance configurations, including color schemes, fonts, font sizes, etc. Users can adjust according to their preferences to make the terminal interface more beautiful and comfortable. iTerm2 has a powerful built-in search function that supports searching for historical commands, text, and other content in the terminal, making it easy for users to find and locate relevant information. In addition, iTerm2 supports terminal plug-ins that help users quickly access commonly used commands and tools, such as zsh, tmux, and more.

item.title: CalmBar 2.6.1
item.description:
System Enhancement Center in the menu bar

CalmBar is a lightweight macOS menu bar comprehensive enhancement suite built with Swift 6, SwiftUI, and AppKit to solve common problems such as thermal control, menu bar congestion, external mouse scroll direction, media application mis-start, system hibernation, battery maintenance, and file cleaning. The software supports Apple Silicon and Intel Mac, can read CPU, GPU, battery and SoC temperature in real time, and provides three fan modes: system automatic, manual speed and intelligent temperature control curve. Users can also collapse the menu bar icon, independently reverse the external mouse wheel, intercept Apple Music, set a timer to prevent sleep and keep the office state. Its charge management supports custom charge caps, return cruises, temporary fulls, and safe fuses, and displays health, cycle counts, and power supply information. Built-in Vision OCR recognizes on-screen text, QR codes, and barcodes, and AI translation is compatible with OpenAI, HY-MT2, Ollama, and vLLM interfaces, covering 38 languages.

item.title: Warp 0.2026.11.03.17.08.stable_00

Powerful Modern Smart Ai Terminal Tools

Warp is a modern terminal and intelligent coding environment for macOS developers that combines traditional command lines, AI coding agents, multi-model scheduling, and team-level governance capabilities in one workflow. Starting from the terminal experience, it supports developers to directly call Claude Code, Codex, Warp Agent and other agents locally. It can also extend the task to run in the cloud through the Oz Agent Platform, which is suitable for complex software engineering scenarios such as code generation, problem troubleshooting, refactoring migration, PR preliminary examination and incident response. Warp Terminal is open source, emphasizing an open agent ecosystem, connectivity to any tool, choice of inference providers and models, and providing codebase indexing, fine-grained permission control, usage visibility, and enterprise compliance capabilities to enable individual developers and teams to organize automated development tasks more efficiently in a familiar command-line interface.

item.title: OpenVoiceFlow native-v0.6.2
item.description:
macOS Open Source Native Voice Input Tool

OpenVoiceFlow is an open source buttons speech dictation tool for macOS. Simply press and hold the specified buttons to start speaking. After releasing, you can enter the transcribed text into the current cursor location. It is suitable for mail, chat, documents, prompts, code review and other scenarios. The software uses Whisper to complete the audio transcription natively on the Mac, the voice is not uploaded to the server, the recording is discarded after the text is generated, and the AI retouching is turned off by default, so the basic dictation can be performed without networking. Users can confirm the radio status through real-time hover windows and waveforms, use personal dictionaries to correct names, team names and technical terms, and configure the expression style of matching scenarios for different applications such as Slack and email. It also offers speech-triggered text extensions, personal information interviews, dictation histories, and multi-size transcription models to select accuracy and speed based on device performance. When you need to organize your statements, you can access OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, or Groq, and you can also use Ollama to finish polishing locally; no matter which word processing backend you choose, audio transcription will always remain on your device.

item.title: OnDevice OCR Pro 3.4.0
item.description:
Batch OCR tool for documents on macOS

OnDevice OCR Pro is an offline OCR and batch document processing tool for Mac that turns scans, images and PDFs into full-text searchable content. It runs entirely on your Mac with no cloud or subscription, so sensitive files stay local, which suits legal, medical, financial and office use. It can watch folders and process new documents automatically, with batch recognition, auto-rotation, image enhancement and smart skipping of already digital PDFs. Built-in multilingual OCR covers Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German and more, and it can extract text only to save disk space. It is well suited to invoices, receipts, contracts and research material.

item.title: SwiftServer 2.2.2

SwiftServer is a powerful iOS and macOS app designed to help system administrators, developers, and IT professionals monitor and manage servers anytime, anywhere. The main functions of SwiftServer include real-time monitoring, comprehensive resource management, code fragment execution, customized terminals, and cross-device synchronization. User feedback shows that the app excels in server management and resource monitoring, especially for professionals who need remote access and real-time data. SwiftServer is a powerful server monitoring and management tool designed for system administrators, developers, and IT professionals. It provides real-time server performance monitoring, file management, and a full-featured terminal, ensuring users have control over their servers anytime, anywhere.

item.title: NovaPad 2.44.30

App launcher for macOS

The application also provides a floating timer window, which can continuously display the remaining time above other software, so that it is easy to confirm the progress at any time. At the same time, it supports to save up to 3 preset timers, so that the focus time, rest interval or daily tasks can be organized more clearly. With the shortcut key operation, you can minimize mouse dependence and make the timing process easier and more coherent. Pebble: Menu Bar Timer is a lightweight time management tool for Mac for users who need a pomodoro, focus timing, learning reminders, and work rhythm control. It puts a timer in the menu bar with floating windows and shortcut keys, allowing you to quickly manage focus and rest periods without interrupting your current tasks.

macOS all-around note-taking tool

Agenda is an Apple Design Award-winning macOS (and iOS) note-taking app that uniquely blends calendar events with notes to help users manage past, present, and future tasks and projects through timeline organization, making daily planning, meeting preparation, and project advancement more efficient and orderly, especially for business people, engineers, teachers, students, and creative workers.

item.title: Scriptation 6.0.10
item.description:
Professional PDF annotation and transfer tool for Mac

Designed for the film, TV, and video industries, Scriptation is an Emmy-winning PDF annotation app that is a revolutionary production tool that intelligently transfers your annotations, notes, and tags into new script revisions. Users can categorize scripts, add scenario descriptions and images, generate reports, and export to a formatted PDF or CSV file for easy integration into other spreadsheets.

macOS Quick Launch and Switch Tool

LaunchPalette is a keyboard shortcut management app and window switching tool for macOS that integrates access to apps, projects, folders, and scripts into a memorable keyboard navigation so you can quickly start and switch without leaving your keyboard. The software supports the use of intuitive combination keys to open common applications, enter the specified project window by hierarchy, trigger AppleScript and shell scripts, and cycle between windows in the order of recent use, reducing the interruptions caused by repeated clicks and searches. It is also compatible with renaming and moving folders and files, and the shortcut keys will automatically remain effective for Mac users who need high-frequency multitasking and want to compress the workflow to the keyboard as much as possible. LaunchPalette is a keyboard navigation tool designed for macOS that integrates app launch, window switching, project directions, and script execution into a single shortcut system that helps users move between tasks faster, reduce mouse dependency, and maintain a coherent work rhythm.
